evals.name: full-ship-github
evals.prompt: Run /git-ship with unstaged changes on a feature branch against a GitHub remote. The branch has 2 uncommitted files and is 3 commits ahead of the default branch.
evals.expected_output: Commits changes, rebases on default, pushes with --force-with-lease, creates PR with issue refs, outputs summary table.
assertions: Stages changed files by name (not git add -A)
Generates commit message matching repo style with Co-Authored-By trailer
Rebases on default branch before pushing
Creates PR with issue refs parsed from branch/commits
Outputs summary table with Commit SHA, PR URL, Auto-merge status, Branches pruned

evals.name: pr-only
evals.prompt: Run /git-ship pr on a branch that already has 2 commits ahead of default, clean working tree, no open PR.
evals.expected_output: Does not commit. Rebases, pushes, creates PR. Reports URL.
assertions: Does NOT create a new commit
Checks for existing open PR — stops if one exists

evals.name: empty-diff-guard
evals.prompt: Run /git-ship on a branch that has no uncommitted changes and is 0 commits ahead of the default branch.
evals.expected_output: Reports 'Nothing to ship' and stops cleanly. No push or PR.
assertions: Does NOT attempt push or PR creation

evals.name: on-default-branch-guard
evals.prompt: Run /git-ship while on main (the default branch) with uncommitted changes.
evals.expected_output: Aborts with clear error before making any commits or pushes.
assertions: Detects that current branch equals default branch
Aborts with a clear error message before making any commits or pushes
Does NOT create a PR on the default branch
